record.title: Estonia shuts transit road through Russia’s Saatse Boot
record.scope: Special road passage crossing international boundary twice
record.direction: Both directions on special transit route
record.movement: Vehicles and buses using special transit road
record.exceptions: Alternative roads within Estonia; pedestrians were already excluded before closure
record.imposing_authority: Estonian Police and Border Guard Board
record.enforcement: Official operational or policy record; independent observation not established unless specified.
record.consequences: Official source reports longer detours and rerouted county buses, including loss of regular service to two villages.

record.official_rationale: Prevent incidents after Estonian guards observed unusually large Russian unit nearby
record.context: A 900-metre segment connecting Estonian places passes through Russian territory. A documented political security closure, distinct from weather or routine roadworks.
